Hi, You're invited to our company dinner! Please join us for an evening of good food and great company.
Date: Thursday, August 20
Time: 6:30 PM – 9:00 PM
Location: The Copper Oak Grill, 412 Maple Avenue, Chicago, IL 60610
Please RSVP by Thursday, August 13, and choose one of the following entrées:
1. Herb-Roasted Chicken – with garlic mashed potatoes and seasonal vegetables
2. Grilled Sirloin Steak – with roasted potatoes and green beans
3. Wild Mushroom Risotto (vegetarian) – with parmesan and fresh herbs
To RSVP, just reply to this email with whether you will attend and your entrée choice. Also please let me know if you need additional accommodation. If none of the options work for you, let me know and I'll check with the restaurant about alternatives.
In addition to your entrée, we'll have a selection of shared appetizers, desserts, drinks for the table.
Looking forward to seeing you there!
Best,
Coordinator
